name: openpixo/game-feel-juice
title: Game feel and impact feedback
description: Add adjustable shake, hit-stop, squash, tweens, particles and camera smoothing to existing gameplay events.

description_i18n.en: Add adjustable shake, hit-stop, squash, tweens, particles and camera smoothing to existing gameplay events.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 为既有玩法事件加入可调节的震屏、顿帧、挤压拉伸、补间、粒子和镜头平滑。

examples.title: Make coins feel satisfying
examples.prompt: In this Phaser sample platformer, add a small visual pop and four short-lived particles when I collect a coin. Keep the score and collision rules unchanged and verify the build.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 给这个 Phaser 平台跳跃示例的金币拾取加入轻微视觉弹跳和四个短寿命粒子，保留分数与碰撞规则，并验证构建。

examples.title: Give landings some weight
examples.prompt: Add a 120 ms squash-and-recover animation and subtle camera shake to landings in my Godot platformer. Keep the collision body stable and add an intensity setting that can disable motion.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 给我的 Godot 平台跳跃游戏加入 120 毫秒落地挤压回弹和轻微震屏，保持碰撞体稳定，并加入可关闭动态效果的强度设置。

examples.title: Add controlled impact hit-stop
examples.prompt: Add about 45 ms of hit-stop when the player takes damage in this Godot 2D game. Make repeated hits, pausing and restarting restore the normal time scale correctly, then run the Godot check.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 给这个 Godot 2D 游戏的玩家受伤加入约 45 毫秒顿帧，确保连续受击、暂停和重开后正确恢复时间倍率，然后运行 Godot 检查。
